description: Drafts what a Speedi listing would say for a trade or service business, for a business that wants to be listed — not for a customer looking for one. It creates no account and lists nobody. It takes fields, not a URL: Speedi fetches nothing and reads nothing. Any source works — a website, a Facebook or Instagram page, a photograph of a van or a business card, or what the business says about itself. It writes nothing and creates no account. It returns what Speedi would list, what is still missing, and a link where the business owner finishes signing up themselves.

bio.description: A few sentences about the business, in their words.

postcode.description: The UK postcode they work from. Speedi looks it up; do not send coordinates.

specialisms.description: The particular things they are known for — EICR, rewires, EV chargers. Kept in their words.

trade.description: Their main trade or service, in ordinary words — Speedi matches it to its own list.

trades.description: Everything else they do. Speedi matches each to its own list; anything it does not recognise is kept as a specialism, so send what the business actually says.

website.description: Their website or page. Recorded as the source — NOT fetched.

name: draft_business_listing
title: Draft a business listing
